description: Wasserschutzgebiete Landkreis Mittelsachsen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by webgis.landkreis-mittelsachsen.de. The metadata set describes all protected areas of the category of water protection areas (drinking water protection areas and dams) of the district of Mittelsachsen, defined by ordinance, with an area of approximately 280 km ². The Landratsamt Mittelsachsen as the Lower Water Authority is responsible for identification, fixing, changing or cancelling. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Water protection areas district of Mittelsachsen" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Wasserschutz, Wasser, Landkreis Mittelsachsen, Wasserschutzgebiete, Gewässer, Mittelsachsen. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. The listing shows 2021-10-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
